deep.preprocessing: grey -> short side 256 -> centre crop 224 -> 3 channels -> ImageNet mean/sd

nonfinite_stats.rule: replaced by the real-frame column median

spaces.stats: 37 image statistics (device_physics.image_stats), standardised inside each fold
spaces.deep: resnet50 avgpool (2048-d), standardised then PCA-256 fitted inside each fold

meta.clusters: person / specimen / phantom / CT subject / acquisition day (C-ArmLSpine), never the frame
meta.intervals: 2.5-97.5 percentiles of 2,000 cluster-resamples of the pooled out-of-fold predictions

stats/svm.metric: balanced accuracy, case-grouped 5-fold, 500 cluster-resamples per cell

stats/logistic.metric: balanced accuracy, case-grouped 5-fold, 500 cluster-resamples per cell

deep/svm.metric: balanced accuracy, case-grouped 5-fold, 500 cluster-resamples per cell

deep/logistic.metric: balanced accuracy, case-grouped 5-fold, 500 cluster-resamples per cell
